# TVAF36-N014JW-R footprint

Project-local hand-solder footprint for Jianfu/ROCPU TVAF36-N014JW-R.

Manufacturer PCB land dimensions used:
- overall X span: 3.75 mm
- inner X gap: 2.50 mm
- Y row pitch: 2.25 mm
- pad height: 1.10 mm
- body: 3.00 x 2.75 mm
- switch height: 1.40 mm

The manufacturer pad width is 0.625 mm. This hand-solder variant keeps the inner pad edges at ±1.25 mm exactly and extends each pad 0.325 mm outward, giving 0.95 x 1.10 mm pads. Pads on the same physical side of the switch contact use duplicate KiCad pad numbers: the two upper terminals are pad 1 and the two lower terminals are pad 2, matching a normal 2-pin SW_Push schematic symbol.
